exceptions.reachability: Next.js pins PostCSS 8.4.31 internally. The website processes repository-owned styles only and never parses or re-embeds user-supplied CSS.
compensatingControls: Content is rendered through React and no user-controlled CSS reaches PostCSS.
The lockfile audit fails when this exception expires or Next.js stops producing the finding.
exceptions.resolution: Upgrade to the first supported Next.js 16 patch that consumes PostCSS 8.5.10 or newer.

exceptions.reachability: Next.js pins sharp 0.34.x as an optional dependency. The current website has no next/image imports or upload path that decodes caller-controlled images.
compensatingControls: User uploads bypass the website image optimizer and use signed private Storage sessions.
Container scanning remains blocking and this exception expires after 30 days.
exceptions.resolution: Upgrade when Next.js officially supports sharp 0.35.0 or newer; do not force an unsupported native dependency override.

exceptions.reachability: Expo and NotifyKit reach uuid 7 only through the xcode project generator. xcode invokes uuid.v4() without a caller-provided buffer; the affected v3/v5/v6 buffer overloads are not used and are absent from the shipped JavaScript runtime path.
compensatingControls: Native projects are generated only in trusted CI/EAS environments from reviewed repository configuration.
Expo Doctor, native release checks, and the expiring lockfile audit guard every mobile dependency change.
exceptions.resolution: Adopt the first Expo 57-compatible xcode release that depends on uuid 11.1.1 or newer.

exceptions.reachability: The affected esbuild copy is a development-only drizzle-kit loader. This repository never starts esbuild's development server and production packages omit drizzle-kit.
compensatingControls: Database tooling runs only on trusted source in isolated developer or CI environments.
Production installs omit development dependencies and the exception expires after 30 days.
exceptions.resolution: Upgrade when drizzle-kit removes @esbuild-kit or publishes a compatible patched dependency graph.

exceptions.reachability: The affected tsx/esbuild development-server behavior is not invoked by drizzle-kit; database scripts compile or migrate trusted local source without exposing an esbuild HTTP server.
compensatingControls: Database tooling is not installed in runtime images.
CI executes migrations only against an isolated loopback Supabase database.
exceptions.resolution: Consume the next compatible drizzle-kit/tsx patch that moves beyond the affected esbuild range.
